name: Gujarat Terce Laboratories Limited
about: Gujarat Terce Laboratories Limited develops, manufactures, markets, and distributes medicines and healthcare products in India and internationally. The company offers generic pharmaceutical for therapeutic areas, such as antibiotics, respiratory, nutraceuticals, gastrology, gynecology, pain therapy, and ayurvedic. It provides tablets, capsules, oral liquids, ointments, and injections under the Acolate, Tynol, Resplash, Ferlit, Z-Oxi, Vitfol, Thyter, Aziter, and Codimol brands. Gujarat Terce Laboratories Limited was incorporated in 1985 and is based in Ahmedabad, India.
